cards.title: Tiny Lantern Reef Paragraph Revision Card
cards.paragraphRevisionSkill: revise one fictional lantern reef path paragraph by improving the topic sentence, detail order, transition, closing sentence, repeated words, and final copy
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable lined paper paragraph revision card for revising one fictional lantern reef path paragraph: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Set lined paper beside this card and choose one pretend lantern reef path moment before the writer starts: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Adult reads: Writer, make one lantern reef path paragraph clearer by changing one part at a time on lined paper: ____________________.
cards.topicSentencePrompt: Adult asks: Write a topic sentence that tells the reader the paragraph is about one lantern reef path: ____________________.
cards.detailOrderPrompt: Adult asks: Number two details so the paper boat detail comes before the button-coral clue: ____________________.
cards.transitionCheckPrompt: Adult asks: Add one small transition, such as first or next, so the writer moves from paper boat to reef clue: ____________________.
cards.closingSentencePrompt: Adult asks: Write a closing sentence that brings the paragraph back to the lantern path: ____________________.
cards.repeatedWordCutPrompt: Adult asks: Circle one repeated lantern word, then replace one copy with a fresh paper word: ____________________.
cards.finalRevisedParagraphPrompt: Adult asks: Copy the final revised paragraph neatly on lined paper with the new topic, details, transition, closing, and word change: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Adult points to one sentence, and the writer changes only that sentence first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Later paper line: Try the same revision steps with a pretend sea-glass path or paper boat paragraph: ____________________.
